notes.content:
[h3]Fire spreads at Tokyo Games Show 🔥[/h3][p][/p][p]We are at Tokyo Game Show, where you can [b]play the first Into the Fire demo[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311911/cd7cfacbf1da3292a471465a4ad63d0f03d70a59.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Visit us at [b]11C04 stand[/b] in the Poland games section between [b]September 25 and September 28[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Extinguish flames on an island burning from the fury of nature and brimming with mystical phenomena...[/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: New screenshots: Buto
notes.content:
[h2]Greet Buto...[/h2][p][/p][p]...[b]the lord of magma[/b], as he rises from the ashes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311911/ef59918f26346974b26ec814efa7bb6752a6aaaf.png"][/img][/p][p]Fed with rice and fruit, the seasonal harvests of entire villages, Buto would melt away for years in his bed of fire and magma. At times, he would roll from side to side or rise ever so slightly to see whether the propitiatory procession was making its way toward him with baskets of abundance. Each of his movements made the earth tremble.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311911/208742794ea299cbccd609fe9a467b485a7ce9c8.png"][/img][/p][p]But the eternal feast of Buto has ended. The Lord of Magma has risen. He now stands among the people, feeding on their fear, drawing their brittle bones into himself, sowing death.


What other mythical beings would you see living in the world of a raging catastrophe fueled with nature's fury? 🔥

- Starward Industries team
[/p]

notes.title: New screenshots: Upacara Ngayau
notes.content: [h2]Have you heard about...[/h2][p][/p][p][b]...Upacara Ngayau?[/b] The Hunt for Fire Demons?[/p][p][/p][p]There are places where the ritual is passed down from generation to generation - where people have entwined their lives with the foothills of a fiery mountain.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311911/335fb7c1f6c0a36a10f24a8f3d9d69e8499ba9f1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Volcano[/b]. The king above the plains, whose single roar can cloak continents in ash, reducing everything around it to dust, only to raise new temples and statues of lava in their place.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311911/9b8a3020501ad5864cd4fb176af4ae5709e6dc74.png"][/img][/p][p]Soon, another legend will follow. Stay tuned for burning stories.[/p][p][/p][p]Starward Industries team 🔥[/p]

notes.title: Into the Fire - fantastical retro arsenal 🔥
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, adventurer,[/h2]

Today, we want to show you fantastical retro inventions that will save lives under your strategic command. All of these tactical weapons and tools (and more!) will become your most trusted protectors while you face the inescapable, raw fury of nature.


[h3]Fire extinguishing shotgun[/h3]

[previewyoutube=2O6PuBTBvoM;full][/previewyoutube]

Your time is running out.

When smoke fills your lungs and fire reaches your feet, you desperately load your shotgun.

Blasting away every bullet you have left feels catharthic.

Water hisses in contact with its sworn enemy and very slowly unveils a narrow path to freedom.

Flames give way to human invention.

Today, you will live.


[h3]Water barrel[/h3]

[previewyoutube=LAUIPLAxT6k;full][/previewyoutube]

When the world is falling to pieces, the weight on your back keeps you grounded.

Armed with liquid ammunition ready to shoot on command, you cross the epicenter of hell.

You jump in the flames and blast water towards the fury of nature.

May your ammo last long enough to save one more life.


[h3]Fire extinguishing gun[/h3]

[previewyoutube=DZLEHvr92Hk;full][/previewyoutube]

Ceiling-high flames close in from every direction.

An ancient power twists and screams, its heat trying to consume your body and soul.

You face the fiery demon and pull the trigger of your gun.

High-pressure water surges forward, the nature's gift fighting the nature's wrath.

As death takes a step back, you push forward.

Not only your life is at stake.


[h3]Fire extinguishing bomb[/h3]

[previewyoutube=5wcCLSQ5A9M;full][/previewyoutube]

Methyl chloride and bromide raining down to choke the flames.

A brutal science. A war against the blaze.

In Into the Fire, you don’t need an airstrike.

You carry that power in your own hands.

Incendiary extinguishing bombs are part of your personal arsenal.

When the world burns and you’re face to face with fire-demons clawing through the smoke — you drop the bomb and buy yourself one more breath.

This is the kind of energy we bring to your adventure.



- Starward Industries

notes.title: Into the Fire GAMEPLAY TRAILER!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy New Gameplay Trailer 🔥[/h2]


[i]75,000 years ago, it almost wiped out life on Earth. Now, the same demons are stirring from a deep, ancient slumber. And with them begins your battle against hellish powers and the fury of nature during a volcanic eruption. As you race through the chaos, saving people and animals, you'll uncover dark, twisted legends more terrifying than you can imagine. Beneath your feet, an eerie force lurks, breaking every rule of science.[/i]


[previewyoutube=WlbEGWwJap0;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the release of our gameplay trailer, we have updated Into the Fire Steam page. [b]See new screenshots, gifs and descriptions.[/b] Add our emotion-fueled extraction survival game, set in the heart of a volcanic disaster, to your wishlist:


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988030/Into_the_Fire/


[i]And most importantly: let us know what you think about the gameplay in the comments![/i]

- Starward Industries team

notes.title: A gameplay sneak peak before tomorrow's trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]See the volcano explode[/h2]

[b]Do you feel the hot breath of adventure on your neck? Don't forget to bring your weapon. The burning battle ahead will be... preternatural.[/b]

A [u]fire extinguishing shotgun[/u] is one of many weapons in your arsenal. Wield it to brave natural disasters, fire demons and your own fears.

[previewyoutube=2O6PuBTBvoM;full][/previewyoutube]

See both on [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/TsDyqgX0XCU]YouTube[/url] or [url=https://www.twitch.tv/iii_initiative]Twitch[/url].[/h3]

notes.title: From Dante's Ring... Into the Fire 🔥
notes.content:
[h2]New title[/h2]

[b][i]There is no escaping raging volcano gods on Dante's Ring archipelago. Challenge the unstoppable forces of nature and step Into the Fire to pull human lives from their grasp.[/i][/b]

[h2]Today, we rename our game to Into the Fire![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311911/cf915c2200a03b457da233e4edc22b2cf5e2dde1.png[/img]

[h2]"But why?"[/h2]

[b][i]We firmly believe that the new title conveys more about the gameplay and the atmosphere present in the game, and that it will ignite your hearts even more.[/i][/b]

Thank you for your continuous support and we hope that you are as excited as we are to see our [b]new game material at Triple-I Initiative showcase on April 10[/b]!

- Starward Industries team

notes.title: Watch our new game video at Triple-I Initiative!
notes.content:

All of this in 45 minutes, beginning on [b]April 10 at 6 pm CEST / 12 pm edt / 9 am pet[/b].

It will be streamed on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@iii_initiative]Youtube[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/iii_initiative]Twitch[/url] and right here on Steam.

You can watch the trailer to get an idea of what it'll be like:
[previewyoutube=zWldd4HloWk;full][/previewyoutube]

Or check out https://iii-initiative.com/ for more information.

We can't wait to show you what we have been working on these last few weeks.
See you at Triple-I!

- Starward Industries team
